description: Header file defining the TConstantUnion class, which represents a union of constant values of various types used in shader translation within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: TConstantUnion
classes.description: Represents a union of constant values (int, uint, float, bool, YUV CSC standard) used in shader translation.

methods.name: setIConst
methods.description: Sets the constant value as an integer.

methods.name: setUConst
methods.description: Sets the constant value as an unsigned integer.

methods.name: setFConst
methods.description: Sets the constant value as a float.

methods.name: setBConst
methods.description: Sets the constant value as a boolean.

methods.name: setYuvCscStandardEXTConst
methods.description: Sets the YUV CSC standard constant.

methods.name: getUConst
methods.description: Retrieves the unsigned integer constant value.

methods.name: isZero
methods.description: Checks if the constant value is zero.

methods.name: getYuvCscStandardEXTConst
methods.description: Retrieves the YUV CSC standard constant.
